title: Can LLMs Express Personality Across Cultures? Introducing CulturalPersonas for Evaluating Trait Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses to scenario-based prompts grounded in specific cultural norms (via both multiple-choice and open-ended formats) and measuring the alignment of their expressed Big Five personality traits with real-world human population distributions from six different countries using Wasserstein distance and Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistics.
